subject: Who pays for the mention
body:
The sponsor side turns a mention into a market. A sponsor page carries its placement history month by month, the publications it runs in, the sponsors sharing inventory with it, and lookalike publications ranked by audience and cadence.

An account appearing in a list a competitor pays for is a different event from an account appearing anywhere, and both carry the publication and the date.

I can send a sample with those fields joined the way your stream would take them.
